names.en: Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool

summary.text: Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool is a refinement path Immortal Gu House that Fang Yuan completes in Mini Central Continent of his immortal aperture. It is built for Gu refinement and has almost no strength in offense, defense, or movement.

claims.text: After months of arrangements in aperture time, Fang Yuan seats rank seven Blood Asset Immortal Gu on a golden seat atop a pavilion in a square pool. Blood light flows down, dyes the white jade-like pavilion crimson, and turns the pool water red like blood. He raised Blood Asset from rank six to rank seven with the Long Hair refinement path formation shortly before that seating.

He conceives the house by merging Immortal Gu Houses and immortal formations, including Regret Pool, Refinement Cauldron, and Long Hair refinement path formation, and the price he pays is shockingly high. He dismantles that Long Hair formation and keeps rank eight Advance Refinement as a core, uses rank eight Regret as the essence of Regret Pool for the pavilion, builds a year essence sub-pool with rank eight Early Autumn, Mid Autumn, and Late Autumn to lead a tributary of the River of Time into the square pool, and puts the incomplete Refinement Sea into the pool with rank eight Water Refinement. The four main cores are rank eight Advance Refinement, Water Refinement, and Regret, plus rank seven Blood Asset, which is why it is named Four Elements; there are over twenty supplementary Immortal Gu and over one hundred million mortal Gu. He puts in almost all of his refinement path Immortal Gu, and also time path, wisdom path, and other paths’ Immortal Gu. He controlled the variant human alliance and extorted Eastern Sea’s Righteous Qi Alliance for a sufficient number of suitable Immortal Gu. Quasi-supreme grandmaster attainment in refinement path and time path is required even to think of the design.

As soon as it is constructed it is the number one refinement path Immortal Gu House in the history of Gu cultivation. Fang Yuan judges that if news spread it could compete with Divine Emperor City and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building for the position of number one Immortal Gu House. It merges the essence of human style Gu refinement and hairy man nature Gu refinement, cutting Immortal Gu refinement cost and raising success rate beyond imagination. The design does not account for conflicting dao marks, so the house can exist only inside the sovereign immortal aperture; if he takes it out, internal friction and rejection of different dao marks make it collapse. Annexing the rank eight grotto-heavens Grand Swine, Novelty, and Time Difference, and refining their heaven path dao marks, meets the lowest requirement; his heaven path dao marks then exceed nine thousand.

With the house, Fang Yuan’s refinement path ability becomes number one in the present world; adding his quasi-supreme refinement path attainment, he is among the top three in refinement path over the span of history.

Fang Yuan’s time path clone later controls the house, pours in rank eight immortal essence, and drives it to its limit: blood-like pool water rises as a reverse waterfall, forms a whirlpool, and yields rank eight Dog Shit Luck on the first attempt after he dismantles Cooking Luck Pot to advance its luck path Immortal Gu. Blood-red light then retreats to the pavilion roof, the seat of Blood Asset Immortal Gu. The pool water is refinement water of the incomplete Refinement Sea mixed with water of the River of Time, processed with Water Refinement as the core. The house has a fifty to sixty percent success rate even when refining rank eight Immortal Gu, a rate Fang Yuan treats as enough to shake the Gu Immortal world and draw crazed attacks from Longevity Heaven and Heavenly Court if it became known.

After careful consideration, Fang Yuan sets aside for the moment the idea of remaking Cooking Luck Pot on the same model, because a house built like this one would lose much of its might outside the aperture, and Cooking Luck Pot must be used outside. Blood Asset is still rank seven for lack of rank eight blood path immortal materials. The fifty to sixty percent rank eight success rate is enough to mass-produce rank eight Immortal Gu, and ordinary refinement would spend at least ten times the immortal materials he spends. With the house, his refinement path strength sits among the top three in history; he holds that even Long Hair Ancestor, who once refined Immortal Gu for Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable, did not have as high a success rate.

The incomplete Refinement Sea came from Lang Ya blessed land as Long Hair Ancestor’s attempt at a refinement path secluded domain of heaven and earth. Fang Yuan lacks spare effort, time, and resources to complete it, and the house intensely consumes that incomplete sea.

After later adjustments the house is much stronger. Including fan wind Gu, Fang Yuan has already refined over fifty rank eight Immortal Gu with it. He Chun Qiu reports that Wu clan’s fan wind Gu advanced successfully after two failures.

The house has Regret Pool’s ability: any Immortal Gu it refines leaves an insignia, and if that Immortal Gu is destroyed the house uses a tributary of the River of Time with the insignia to refine it again at a higher success rate than refining a new rank eight Immortal Gu. He Chun Qiu takes charge while the water of time moves in the pool, and in a few days all destroyed rank eight Immortal Gu from an earlier battle are refined.

Inside the house, grey fire like a mountain melts wood path immortal materials over ten thousand year profound ice that seals rank eight Heavenly Essence Treasure Imperial Lotus. Assisting Gu Immortals read the method as ice refinement fused with fire refinement, and in essence as the human isolation style combined with hairy man natural Gu refinement. Tiny flaws in processing the wood path immortal materials accumulate until Fang Yuan’s refinement path intuition forces him to stop; rank nine immortal materials are wasted, the assisting Gu Immortals take mild injuries, and the house is damaged. A sudden failure without that stop would destroy the house completely, or leave only a small portion.
The house later erupts with unparalleled light as Heavenly Essence Treasure Imperial Lotus is successfully elevated, and its rank nine aura fills the entire aperture.

After Fang Yuan raises Advance Refinement to rank nine, he treats the house as about to rise to rank nine as well, a rank of Immortal Gu House that is rare in human history. He must modify the earlier house to make it suitable for rank nine Advance Refinement before placing that Gu back in. He judges that once it is a true rank nine it would suppress Divine Emperor City, which has no rank nine Immortal Gu, and that a ranking list of Immortal Gu Houses would then put it first. Heaven Overseeing Tower is the most famous such house; with rank nine fate Gu destroyed it cannot be constructed again.

After that rank nine Advance Refinement is added, the house becomes a genuine rank nine Immortal Gu House. It still has the same four cores: Advance Refinement at rank nine, and Water Refinement, Regret, and Blood Asset at rank eight. Blood Asset has reached its limit and cannot be raised to rank nine; Heavenly Court’s suppression of blood path development is the cause. The house was created before the battle in Crazed Demon Cave; once Fang Yuan is a refinement path supreme grandmaster he can modify it, and it gains a huge boost in refining Gu. He uses the pool to cleanse his soul: extra arms vanish and he returns to one head, weakening the drawback of his soul path cultivation.

Core Gu.text: Advance Refinement Gu Water Refinement Gu Regret Gu Blood Asset Immortal Gu
